headline: Record volumes lift revenue, losses widen, outlook raised
summary_short: Natera's Q1 2026 revenue climbed 38.8% y/y to $696.6M on record test volumes (>1M processed, oncology +54.4% y/y), while the GAAP net loss widened to $85.1M (-$0.60/share) as R&D and SG&A outgrew gross profit; management raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $2.74B-$2.82B from $2.62B-$2.70B.
summary_long: Revenue grew 38.8% y/y to $696.6M as processed test volume topped 1 million units for the first time (+18.5% y/y), led by oncology (+54.4% y/y, a record quarter for volume growth). Gross margin rose to 64.7% from 63.1% on higher revenue and continued progress reducing cost of revenues. R&D ($210.7M, +$81.6M y/y) and SG&A ($327.9M, +$61.0M y/y) together outpaced the $134.1M gross-profit gain, widening the operating loss to $93.5M and net loss to $85.1M (-$0.60/share) from $66.9M (-$0.50/share). Cash rose to $1,087.9M from $1,076.1M at year-end. Natera raised FY2026 guidance: revenue to $2.74B-$2.82B (from $2.62B-$2.70B) and R&D to $800M-$900M (from $750M-$850M); SG&A guidance held at $1.125B-$1.225B.

drivers.explanation: Company frames the quarter as a record — first time exceeding 1M processed tests, record quarterly oncology volume growth — supporting a raised full-year revenue and R&D outlook.
Growth driven by an increase in volume and average selling price improvements; test volume up 18.5% y/y with oncology tests up 54.4% y/y.
Margin rose to 64.7% from 63.1% primarily as a result of higher revenues and continued progress in reducing cost of revenues associated with tests processed.
R&D (+$81.6M y/y) and SG&A (+$61.0M y/y) combined rose $142.6M y/y, outpacing the $134.1M y/y gross-profit gain, driven by headcount growth and higher clinical trial expenses.
Net loss widened as the $142.6M y/y increase in R&D plus SG&A exceeded the $134.1M y/y gross-profit gain.
Positive cash inflow of approximately $11.8M in the quarter, per the release's cash-flow footnote (operating +$40.2M, financing +$3.7M, investing -$32.1M).
